org6de[other]_0: From my experience in my previous job, i learned that creating training material and giving trainings is of great value, but the time investment is so high, that when they would be sold commercially, basically no revenue can be generated. Also it probably takes a few years until a training is well-polished, requiring repeated testing of the training material. I think allocating a budged per employee per year, to attend to external trainings or buy access to training material is a better effort to satisfly the broad range of possible skills and give everyone the opportunity to excell their knowledge specifically in the area where its needed, individually. I think an RSE community benefits from a broad range of skills, distributed across many people, that have an easy path to exchange information and feel comfortable doing so. In the end, a tight connection between juniors and seniors is a very good way to educate
